For flying, I recommend a 10,000–20,000 mAh USB-C power bank from Anker, UGREEN, or Nitecore. This is the sweet spot for portability, charging speed, and airline compatibility.

The most important consideration is airline safety rules:

Under 100 Wh: Generally permitted in carry-on baggage without airline approval.

100–160 Wh: May require airline approval, and some airlines prohibit them.

Over 160 Wh: Generally prohibited on passenger flights.

Checked baggage: Spare power banks are not allowed. Keep them in your carry-on.

Some airlines also restrict using or charging power banks during flights, even when carrying them is permitted.
